relationships.subject: NaViPA1
relationships.evidence_quote: NaViPA1h inhibited TTX-S NaV channels and attenuated excitability of sensory neurons.

relationships.subject: p38 MAPK
relationships.evidence_quote: Another example of the modulation of channel density is provided by the observation that treatment of DRG neurons with anisomycin causes an increase in NaV1.8 current density in a p38 MAPK dependent manner, due to the phosphorylation of SP dipeptides in the L1 of the channel (25).

key_findings: Commentary on Shin et al.: an AAV-delivered peptide aptamer (NaViPA1) targeting a short linear motif in Nav1.7 loop 1 suppresses TTX-S currents and produces analgesia in rats.
Cytoplasmic short linear motifs of NaV channels regulate trafficking and density, offering gene-therapy targets.
